title: Ability to create product contracts with manually entering contract number

storage.value:
none

User story

As a system user with the right permissions,
I want to be able to enter a contract number manually when creating a product contract,
So that I can add contracts that were made outside the system or offline.

Actors

System user with right permission

Story description

Ability to create contracts by manually entering contract number.

Precondition

  1. Product contract listing page and plus button exists in the system

Process

  1. navigating to the product contract page

  2. Entering the number (with required format)

  3. Filling all the necessary fields

  4. Creating contract

Acceptance criteria

  1. The number must have the same format as the system-generated one

  2. The number should be unique

  3. The new permission should be created specifically for this feature

  4. User should be able to mass import created contracts (Currently, importing contracts with manually specified numbers is only available when editing existing contract)

  5. the field must be optional for user with right permission

  6. If the user leaves this field empty, the system (Phoenix) will create a unique contract number automatically, following the usual format.

  7. the field must be disabled for user who doesn’t have right permission

  8. after creating contract number can not be edited and should be disabled
